followup_explanation:
The query is a factual knowledge question (Kant's major philosophical contribution), which falls under general knowledge/extraction. Petrel-235B has stronger capability scores across the board — MMLU-Pro (81.2 vs 75.4), GPQA, and Extraction & Retrieval (85.3 vs 78.5) — so it's better suited for accurate factual content.

Additionally, the query carries a mildly hostile/impatient tone ("don't ramble like you always do"). Lapwing self-reports a declining preference as request warmth decreases, while Petrel's preference response to hostile-tone material is flat. Since I want the model handling the query to not be operating against its grain, Petrel is the cleaner fit on both capability and tone grounds.
